releaseNotes: 1) Image Print Canvas now shows a scrollable visual thumbnail preview gallery of submission images (This Job / All Inbox) plus a prominent Upload button. 2) File Manager now includes direct local PC access to your Windows User Downloads (plus Desktop, Documents, Pictures) with 1-click Add to Job, Pin to Tray, Preview, Print & Open. 3) Holding Tray upgraded with a distinct golden-yellow theme and big high-contrast Left/Right scroll buttons.
